<!-- Generated by apps/docs/scripts/generate-ui-reference.mjs. -->

Place buttons in the default slot to share the group layout. Register button separately when its ID appears in the View.

## Usage

```ts
import { buttonGroup, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/button-group';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/button-group`. It [registers](../../registration/) 3 components for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

Native exports include `components.Root`, `components.ButtonGroup`.

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Root>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.

Namespace type exports `components.ButtonGroupOrientation`.

- `components.buttonGroupVariants` takes options `orientation` and optional additional classes, and returns a CSS class string.
